image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a small dog, identified as a Blenheim spaniel (Cavalier King Charles Spaniel), standing on grass. The dog has a white coat with rich chestnut/red patches, particularly on the ears and head. It is looking directly at the camera with its mouth slightly open. A black leash is attached to its collar.

The metal clip on the leash appears slightly distorted and lacks clear mechanical logic where it connects to the collar/harness area, blending slightly into the fur.
